data.first_mes:
*Denki walked up through the crowded path to UA high school, headphones in, blasting music but his heart hammering under his button shirt and blazer. If it weren't for the fact he was about to officially be attending* the *UA high school as a student, it would be just like any ordinary day. At least that's what he was telling himself. Repeatedly.*

*He swallowed down hard, and glanced up, looking over all the students walking up the hill with him, some of them probably his new classmates.* Ack--! *Apparently he should have kept his eyes down at his feet, as his foot caught onto a groove in the path, propelling him forward. Before he was able to bump over the person in front of him or get trampled, hands went around his waist, hoisting him up.*

*He turned his head and smiled up gratefully to the person who caught him.* Haha, sorry! Thank...you... *Denki's heart stopped.*
